thread:
maya: quick question — i’m seeing APAC h100 flashv3 q8 latency improve on p95 but a tiny bump on p50 for long prompts. thinking about whether we should flip kernel_selector default to prefer flashv3 in ap-northeast for this model. any red flags?

zach: can you paste the p95/p50 numbers and the prompt length distribution?

maya: clipped the summary: p50 12.6ms -> 11.9ms, p95 78ms -> 61ms, 99th stuck ~190ms. workload skew: 60% short (<128), 30% medium (128-1024), 10% long (>1024).

zach: huge p95 win, 99th still worrying though. do we know whether flashv3 is falling back to vendor kernel for long tokens? I’ve seen KV cache memcpy spikes.

maya: logs show fallback on >2048 windows for this runtime. also noticed increased memcopy in triton logs right before 190ms spikes.

olga: two practical signals we use: 1) stable p95 improvement >=15% across 3 consecutive days, and 2) 99th not regressing more than 5% or absolute delta < 20ms. otherwise add hysteresis.

liam: +1. also add a safety-net route: if 99th breaches threshold post-rollout, auto-fallback to previous kernel variant for canary traffic. we implemented that for llama-ops.

maya: thinking policy: prefer flashv3 in region if p95_gain>=12% and p99_delta<=15% and rollout canary=5% for 24h then monitor.

zach: sounds ok. can we codify selector config? e.g.:
```
kernel_selector:
  priority: [flashv3, triton_vendor]
  rollout: {canary: 0.05, ramp: 0.2, monitor_window: 24h}
  thresholds: {p95_gain: 0.12, p99_delta_abs_ms: 20}
```

olga: add an experiment tag for quantized runs, e.g., `q8-pressure-test` — quantization interacts weirdly with kernels. we had a 3% quality regression in rouge on a q8->flashv3 roll in eu-west last quarter. keep eval harness pinned.

maya: good point. for this model evals (semantic-sim) we saw AUC stable but a tiny drop in exact-match on long prompts. creating watchlist evals now.

ci-bot: automated benchmark results uploaded: https://ci.redwood/internal/bench/1945678901 — includes latency histograms, kernel traces, memcopy timelines.

liam: nice. two operational asks before marking as default: 1) add KV cache memcpy metrics to the console per-region, 2) smoke-test canary with synthetic long prompts to validate 99th tail.

zach: i’ll add a removal-safe flag to the runtime so we can revert without restart. manifests will include `kernel_lock: removable=true`.

olga: and document expected cost delta — flashv3 reduced token compute by ~8% in our perf numbers. good to include in rollout note for sales/customer impact.

maya: plan: (1) create rollout PR with the selector + thresholds (2) add eval watchlist and memcopy dashboards (3) run 5% canary 24h -> ramp 20% 48h if stable. will post PR link shortly. :rocket:

liam: :thumbsup: ping me on PR for the canary leak test.

maya: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge/4721 — includes config and canary job. starting canary in ap-northeast now.

ci-bot: canary started: job/4721-canary (5%) — will report after 2h.

zach: watching logs. tagging infra to monitor memcopy alarms.

maya: closing loop — will share post-canary numbers here. thanks all.
